description: "Vista Oculta" focuses on planetary topography and AI orchestration. We are building an auditable CAD engine that processes digital elevation models (Earth, Moon, Mars) with mathematical error margins and hashed logs. We aim to demonstrate advanced AI agent orchestration to find planetary analogs. If you have skills in planetary geology, GIS, UI/UX, or storytelling for a killer 30s pitch, join us to build verifiable science for Space Apps and LPSC!
